    Retractions of ray tables (Lemma 8.9 at ray level) #

    lem:representation-transfer: a table S embedded in a table T by a unital morphism that is injective on rays, such that a ray of T whose product with an embedded ray is embedded is itself embedded (on either side). The projection of kT onto the embedded rays is then an S-bimodule retraction, and Lemma 4.6 shows that kS is representation-finite when kT is.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
